measurements: All processes on one PC. RTT uses only server os.clock; paired arrival differences use one client clock. Wall time is a same-PC diagnostic; GetServerTimeNow is an estimate. No injected latency/loss.
interpretation: The earlier 183-185 ms samples were startup observations, not a steady-state network benchmark.
Steady-state server-to-client removal on the same PC averaged 17-18 ms; p95 was 22-27 ms. This is not an internet estimate.
Background client render intervals had median about 66.6 ms (about 15 FPS). Removal-to-next-RenderStepped added mean 23-26 ms for the production route.
Ordinary deletion and fast confirmation tied in this controlled steady-state run; no throughput or latency win over baseline is claimed here.
The first samples included startup stalls up to about 2.2 seconds. High startup latency remains distinct from the steady-state values.
GetServerTimeNow is an estimated clock. The benchmark retains server os.clock round trips, same-PC wall-time observations, paired per-client differences and first subsequent render-step timing.
